ReadyClip Privacy Policy

Effective November 27, 2026

This policy describes how ReadyClip handles your information when you use its video editing apps and website.

Footage and editing

ReadyClip uses the videos you choose in Photos, Files or a desktop file picker. It processes the video, its audio and media metadata on your device to find highlights, show previews and produce exports. ReadyClip does not automatically send your source footage or exports to a ReadyClip server. You can edit without creating a ReadyClip account.

Storage and permissions

ReadyClip stores settings and can create temporary copies, previews and exports in app storage. Where the operating system permits it, ReadyClip can keep access to a file you selected so it can read the file during editing. ReadyClip uses your operating system’s app storage controls and permissions to limit access. You can change permissions or clear the app’s data using your device’s settings. Saved files in Photos, Gallery or Files remain in the location you selected until you delete them. Device backups and cloud-synced folders follow your device and storage provider settings.

Sharing and external services

When you share, ReadyClip passes the selected export and the information needed to open it to your operating system’s share sheet or the sharing service you select. A destination such as Instagram, Facebook or TikTok can process the video and information about your account, device or sharing request as part of that service. Review the destination’s privacy policy and sharing settings before posting.

Website and support

The ReadyClip website and its download links are hosted by GitHub. GitHub handles website and download requests under its privacy statement. If you contact support, we use the information you provide to respond and resolve the issue.

For support, privacy questions or requests to remove information you provided to us, contact the ReadyClip maintainers through the ReadyClip issue tracker. The tracker is public. Please keep personal information and private footage out of your initial message.
